attempted_operation: resolve the ffprobe executable to probe a video container
observable_symptoms: where.exe ffprobe returns the Python310 Scripts ffprobe shim before the real WinGet Links ffprobe; the probe returns wrong or empty metadata
root_cause: PATH lists a Python Scripts ffprobe shim ahead of the real WinGet ffprobe
correction: resolve ffprobe as the sibling of the resolved ffmpeg and filter out any Python Scripts source
prevention_rule: never trust where.exe ffprobe; resolve ffprobe next to the resolved ffmpeg binary

verification_case.test: ffprobe path does not contain Python Scripts

attempted_operation: run a Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker script that contains a non-ASCII character
observable_symptoms: 5.1 reads a BOM-less ps1 as ANSI; a UTF-8 em dash yields Unexpected token and the hash literal was incomplete; the worker exits 1 with no output
root_cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 decodes a BOM-less .ps1 as ANSI, corrupting any non-ASCII byte
correction: keep 5.1 workers ASCII-only or add a UTF-8 BOM; grep for non-ASCII bytes before shipping
prevention_rule: 5.1 workers must be ASCII-only or BOM-marked; pwsh 7 is unaffected

evidence.snippet: Unexpected token / hash literal was incomplete

attempted_operation: collect a helper's array return with @(helper) then foreach over the result
observable_symptoms: a helper that returns comma out collected with array-subexpression yields a one-element array wrapping the inner array; a later foreach iterates once over the whole array with no error and wrong results
root_cause: PowerShell array double-wrap: returning comma out then wrapping with array-subexpression nests the array
correction: build into a List of object and return acc ToArray with no leading comma
prevention_rule: never return comma x then wrap; use a List plus ToArray

verification_case.test: helper output length equals element count

evidence.snippet: module list rendered as one unreadable row

attempted_operation: run a fan-out task that holds a persistent llama-server across a blocking call
observable_symptoms: an orphaned llama-server locks a running marker file and livelocks the poll loop while the heartbeat stays fresh; the watchdog is blind
root_cause: a blocking task orphaned a persistent llama-server that held a running marker
correction: launch persistent servers detached, reap the child tree before finalize, assert zero orphans
prevention_rule: persistent model servers run detached and are reaped before finalize; assert zero orphans every wave

verification_case.test: orphan llama-server count after a wave

attempted_operation: ship a module commit through dev.ship under the git lease
observable_symptoms: dev.ship reports committed false because a post-commit git check tripped on an untracked to-delete file; a stale zero-byte git index lock then blocks the next git add
root_cause: dev.ship post-commit check false-negatives on untracked files and leaves a stale index lock
correction: verify the real HEAD via native git log and git show --stat, not dev.ship committed; clear the index lock via an executor task
prevention_rule: trust native git for HEAD, not the dev.ship committed field; clear a stale index lock before re-commit

verification_case.test: native git HEAD matches the intended commit

evidence.snippet: committed:false; nothing added but untracked files present
